propose.title: Headstash claim page: set Apricot Glow theme on terpy + thioly
propose.description: Sets the Headstash claim page theme (R12) on the DAO-owned cw-headstash instances terpy terp16ww6y3e7y63v98d9jzg0cft2u0ztx5kda0zvr0e90kwawh4hxweqhtvv7q and thioly terp1yc4qtcwzv6g55vqrj95xq8anruwyy2ly4narcqs4a2hzgnu6rlrsa4s9r7 via the owner-only set_theme. Theme: Apricot Glow (https://permissionless.money/alpha/wd-colours/apricot-glow.html), light and dark token sets (bg, surface, surfaceAlt, text, textMuted, border, borderStrong, accent, onAccent, focus), canonical JSON sha256 996a1f26bd5affa32a97a744f3b0c89a7a9fdc1ea40a12f1f79d51c5ae06fde4. The contract validates every token (#RRGGBB, no unknown fields); the page validates again and falls back to the frontend manifest default, then the built-in theme. No funds move. Reverting is set_theme {theme: null}.
